title: Sales quickstart deck visuals: create annotated slide assets derived from product screenshots
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a small, reusable set of polished slide visuals for Sales and Solutions engineers that showcase Redwood Inference onboarding and quickstart flows. These assets will be derived from current product screenshots (Console / API keys / Model selection / Rollout controls / Observability dashboards) and packaged as annotated 16:9 slide templates plus cropped hero images for one-pagers and email templates. Visual outputs should work across Hosted / Dedicated / Private narratives and include versions with redacted customer data and blurred PII as needed.

Deliverables:
- 6 annotated slides (16:9): Hero, Quickstart steps, Model Catalog highlight, Dedicated capacity callout, Private deployment overview, Observability snapshot.
- 12 export assets: high-res PNG (4320x2430) and 2x SVG/PNG for each hero/crop for web/email.
- Figma source file with components, tokens, and an "export-ready" page.
- Redaction spec and overlay component: how to blur/mask sensitive sections consistently.
- Notes for Sales: short captions and one-sentence callouts per slide.

Constraints & design principles:
- Keep language short and prescriptive for slides (1–2 lines max).
- Follow product color palette and typography tokens from Design System (use token names, not hard-coded values).
- Provide alternate compositions for dark-mode screenshots and light-mode screenshots.
- Ensure accessibility: contrast ratios and ALT text for exported assets.

Screenshot sources and required coordination:
- Console latest build: ENG PR #6742 (needs final screenshot after GA styling).
- Private deployment screenshots: ENG-5187 will deliver images in /drive/redwood/private-screenshots.
- Observability dashboard: request high-res export from Analytics team (dash export ticket: ENG-7019).

Notes for Sales enablement: prepare a short "how to present" doc with a 30s script for each slide (deliverable as plain text next to Figma exports).
acceptance_criteria: Six 16:9 slides exported as high-res PNGs (4320x2430) and 2x web PNGs/SVGs delivered to Drive
Figma source file with named layers, components, and a dedicated 'exports' page shared with Sales and Solutions
Redaction spec documented (examples + one-click Figma mask) and included in the Figma guide
Slide captions and 30s presenter script completed and accepted by Sales lead (Kira Patel)
Assets reviewed and QA'd against console-2025.03 visuals; no visual regressions or clipped screenshots
